name: WAVEFRNT
recent: WaveFront Berhad 于2026年8月26日召开第37届常年股东大会，所有决议均获通过。公司截至2026年6月30日季度营收为8912万令吉，环比增长13.8%，但录得净亏损561万令吉。此外，公司于2026年8月28日宣布首席财务官一职变动。
notable: 第37届常年股东大会于2026年8月26日举行，所有决议获股东通过。
公司截至2026年6月30日季度营收环比增长13.8%至8912万令吉，但净亏损561万令吉。
公司于2026年8月28日宣布首席财务官（Principal Officer）一职变动。
risks: 截至2026年6月30日季度录得净亏损561万令吉，净利率为负6.3%。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日季度，营收为8912万令吉，环比增长13.8%，但同比下滑7.5%；净亏损561万令吉，净利率为负6.3%，而上一季度净利率为0.1%。

recent_en: WaveFront Berhad held its 37th Annual General Meeting on 26 August 2026, with all resolutions passed. For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM89.12 million, up 13.8% QoQ, but the company recorded a net loss of RM5.61 million. Separately, the company announced a change in principal officer on 28 August 2026.
notable_en: The 37th AGM was held on 26 August 2026 and all resolutions were passed by shareholders.
Revenue for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 rose 13.8% QoQ to RM89.12 million, but a net loss of RM5.61 million was recorded.
The company announced a change in Principal Officer on 28 August 2026.
risks_en: A net loss of RM5.61 million was recorded for the quarter ended 30 June 2026, with a net margin of negative 6.3%.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM89.12 million, up 13.8% QoQ but down 7.5% YoY; net loss was RM5.61 million with a net margin of negative 6.3%, compared with a net margin of 0.1% in the previous quarter.
